evidence: Has the P2P label and adds network protocol messages, a new service bit (NODE_UTXO_SET), and chunk handling in src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Implements an in-band P2P distribution mechanism for AssumeUTXO snapshots to eliminate out-of-band centralized sourcing. While reviewers raise significant architectural and trust objections to introducing multi-gigabyte unvalidated snapshot transfers into the trustless protocol, enabling native P2P snapshot sharing represents a substantial strategic enhancement to initial node sync UX.
